BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

2. When learning Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Building Drawing.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

6. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Wall Finishes.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wall Finishes.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wall Finishes.

7. When learning Ceilings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ceilings.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ceilings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Ceilings.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceilings.

8. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Drawing.

9. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Waste Water Disposal.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Waste Water Disposal.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Waste Water Disposal.

10. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.

11. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Material Schedules.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Building Material Schedules.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.

12. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Maintenance of Plumbing Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Building Construction Project Phase 11 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
